notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the May 3, 2018 version of 2018_03_policy_6_2_1_pdf_2017jun.txt: the only differences are the 'Last Updated' date, a policy URL, page-break positions of unchanged sentences, a comma, and 'Schomburg Center Fellowships' added to the prestigious-fellowship list; no provision differs.

Governing document: University Policy 6.2.1 (Last Updated April 17, 2017, the version in force on 2018-02-22) is the faculty leave policy and covers professors in all units except Weill Cornell Medical College; missing is therefore false. The faculty handbook chapters are an older edition that defer to Policy 6.2.1; where they differ (tenure clock 'on request ... up two semesters'), Policy 6.2.1 governs (source precedence). 2018_02 is a landing page with metadata only; 2018_01 is an HR summary page that names the academic policy and, for staff, NY Paid Family Leave and an extended bonding leave program (coded c17, c18 with faculty_group 'staff members', summary_only).

Birth parent chain: Short-term Medical Leave (c1, up to 6 months; childbirth period c2 ~8 weeks at full salary within it) -> Cornell Academic Parental Leave relief up to one semester (c3, consecutive_after c2: same or contiguous semester) ; FMLA 12 workweeks (c9) concurrent_with c1 and c3 from the start; unpaid/bridging leave (c10) consecutive_after c1 if STML is exhausted pending LTD.
Non-birth parent chain: Cornell Academic Parental Leave relief up to one semester (c3) with FMLA 12 workweeks (c9) concurrent from its start; c2 link ignored for this role.

CAPL relief's exact nature is set by each dean's guidelines (not saved); professors receive teaching relief with research and advising continuing (R4c: 'Just teaching'). Entitlement coded guaranteed_on_request (approval explicitly not discretionary) but flagged as possibly negotiated (R12).

No leave_limits: 'Academic leaves are expected not to exceed one year in length, except as may occur as a result of medically based leave, Family and Medical Leave' excludes the parental leaves; STML's six months per twelve months is a single-component limit. No cap_weeks_all_sources.

Calendar: semester calendar stated ('fall or spring semesters'), no term length except the contract-unit 'four-and-one-half-month semester' for sabbatical pay (pay purposes, not used, R8); calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Not components: sabbatical, study, professional development, prestigious fellowship, IPA, military, volunteer firefighter, jury, funeral and blood-donation leave (not usable for a birth); dual-career leave scheduling encouragement; sabbatic postponement credit for family circumstances; staff short-term disability (named only as not applying to academics); child care grant, dependent-care FSA, CARE Fund, back-up child care (financial or service benefits, not leave).
